THIRD-PARTY NOTICES FOR dist/article/mercury.web.js
==============================================================================

dist/article/mercury.web.js is the unmodified browser bundle of Mercury Parser
(@jocmp/mercury-parser 3.1.1), copied byte for byte from package/dist/mercury.web.js
in the npm tarball recorded in build/mercury-asset.json.

The bundle incorporates the components listed below. The list is taken from the
bundle's source map; versions are those recorded in the upstream package-lock.json
at the source commit. Each license text is reproduced as distributed by the
component (trailing whitespace removed), except where a note says otherwise.
